query: What data governance steps are required (IRB, data access roles, de-identification, audit logs), and who will be responsible for maintenance and scalability to resource-limited sites?

response.query: What data governance steps are required (IRB, data access roles, de-identification, audit logs), and who will be responsible for maintenance and scalability to resource-limited sites?
response.answer: Data governance requires IRB approval, defined data access roles, de-identification of sensitive data, and audit logs. Maintenance and scalability for resource-limited sites will be overseen by a dedicated data governance team.
